### Terms we use

We use the following acronyms and wording:

**AgR**: Agreed Removal  
**FTPCRH**: Fitness to Practise Committee restoration hearing  
**FTPCSH**: Fitness to Practise Committee substantive hearing **FTPCSM**: Fitness to Practise Committee substantive meeting  
**FTPCSORH**: Fitness to Practise Committee substantive order review hearing  
**FTPCSORM**: Fitness to Practise Committee substantive order review meeting

**FTPCIO**: Fitness to Practise Committee interim orders hearing or meeting  
**ICIO**: Investigating Committee interim orders hearing or meeting  
**ICFESH**: Investigating Committee incorrect or fraudulent entry substantive hearing  
**ICFESM**: Investigating Committee incorrect or fraudulent entry substantive meeting

**Resuming**: Hearings which have previously been adjourned part heard.

**Adjourned**: The case is considered by a panel but is not started and the charges are not read. When the case comes back it can be heard before a different panel.

**Adjourned part heard**: The case is considered by the panel, the charges are read and the case must come back before the same panel. When the case comes back it will be listed as ‘resuming’.

**Allegation Type**: This is the charge served on the nurse or midwife, but it may be subject to amendment during the course of the hearing. In the case of resuming hearings, the listed charge will be the same as that which was originally published in respect of the initial hearing. It will not reflect any changes which have arisen during the earlier hearings, whether these are due to amendments to the charges or findings made by the panel.
